def _calc_sampled_segments(self) -> Tuple[Sequence[TaborSegment], Sequence[int]]:
        """
        Returns:
            (segments, segment_lengths)
        """
        time_array, segment_lengths = get_sample_times(self._parsed_program.waveforms, self._sample_rate)

        if np.any(segment_lengths % 16 > 0) or np.any(segment_lengths < 192):
            raise TaborException('At least one waveform has a length that is smaller 192 or not a multiple of 16')

        segments = []
        for i, waveform in enumerate(self._parsed_program.waveforms):
            t = time_array[:segment_lengths[i]]
            marker_time = t[::2]
            segment_a = self._channel_data(waveform, t, 0)
            segment_b = self._channel_data(waveform, t, 1)
            assert (len(segment_a) == len(t))
            assert (len(segment_b) == len(t))
            marker_a = self._marker_data(waveform, marker_time, 0)
            marker_b = self._marker_data(waveform, marker_time, 1)
            segment = TaborSegment.from_sampled(ch_a=segment_a,
                                   ch_b=segment_b,
                                   marker_a=marker_a,
                                   marker_b=marker_b)
            segments.append(segment)
        return segments, segment_lengths

    def setup_single_sequence_mode(self) -> None:
        assert self.program.depth() == 1
        assert self.program.is_balanced()

def _calc_sampled_segments(self) -> Tuple[Sequence[TaborSegment], Sequence[int]]:
        """
        Returns:
            (segments, segment_lengths)
        """
        time_array, segment_lengths = get_sample_times(self._parsed_program.waveforms, self._sample_rate)

        if np.any(segment_lengths % 16 > 0) or np.any(segment_lengths < 192):
            raise TaborException('At least one waveform has a length that is smaller 192 or not a multiple of 16')

        # Deduplicate segments by their hash to avoid uploading identical waveforms multiple times
        segments = []
        segment_hashes = []
        seen_hash_to_index = {}
        
        for i, waveform in enumerate(self._parsed_program.waveforms):
            t = time_array[:segment_lengths[i]]
            marker_time = t[::2]
            segment_a = self._channel_data(waveform, t, 0)
            segment_b = self._channel_data(waveform, t, 1)
            assert (len(segment_a) == len(t))
            assert (len(segment_b) == len(t))
            marker_a = self._marker_data(waveform, marker_time, 0)
            marker_b = self._marker_data(waveform, marker_time, 1)
            segment = TaborSegment.from_sampled(ch_a=segment_a,
                                               ch_b=segment_b,
                                               marker_a=marker_a,
                                               marker_b=marker_b)
            segment_hash = segment._hash
            if segment_hash not in seen_hash_to_index:
                seen_hash_to_index[segment_hash] = len(segments)
                segments.append(segment)
                segment_hashes.append(segment_hash)
            # If hash already seen, we skip adding the segment to avoid redundancy

        # Recalculate segment_lengths to only include unique segments in order of first appearance
        unique_segment_indices = []
        for i, waveform in enumerate(self._parsed_program.waveforms):
            t = time_array[:segment_lengths[i]]
            marker_time = t[::2]
            segment_a = self._channel_data(waveform, t, 0)
            segment_b = self._channel_data(waveform, t, 1)
            marker_a = self._marker_data(waveform, marker_time, 0)
            marker_b = self._marker_data(waveform, marker_time, 1)
            segment = TaborSegment.from_sampled(ch_a=segment_a,
                                               ch_b=segment_b,
                                               marker_a=marker_a,
                                               marker_b=marker_b)
            segment_hash = segment._hash
            if segment_hash in seen_hash_to_index:
                unique_segment_indices.append(seen_hash_to_index[segment_hash])
            else:
                # This case should not happen as we add all hashes above, but handle it just in case
                unique_segment_indices.append(len(segments))
                seen_hash_to_index[segment_hash] = len(segments)
                segments.append(segment)
                segment_hashes.append(segment_hash)

        # Build new segment_lengths based on unique segments
        unique_lengths = np.array([segment_lengths[idx] for idx in unique_segment_indices], dtype=np.int64)

        return segments, unique_lengths
